title: WF03 Find accept and finish an online match

nodes.title: Trigger
body: Actor: Online player A, Online player B, Photon service

nodes.title: 2 Poll canonical offer and accept
body: Responsibility: Player decision and Game API

nodes.title: 3 Wait for all required human acceptances
body: Responsibility: Game API and required peers

nodes.title: 4 Start Photon Shared session and play
body: Responsibility: Players and Photon Shared peers

nodes.title: 5 Report consistent results and read finalized rating
body: Responsibility: Participant reports and Game API

nodes.title: Business outcome
body: A canonical match result updates each participant once.

nodes.title: Exception path
body: A decline/timeout cancels the offer; a conflicting report blocks normal
Reject mutation; preserve state; show retry or policy outcome.

note: Owner slot M3 is proposed, not a named commitment. Actors are identified in the trigger; API/service responsibilities are internal.
